DESCRIPTION:
The Innistrad: Midnight Hunt - Draft Booster Box Case contains 6 Innistrad: Midnight Hunt Draft Booster Boxes. Each Innistrad: Midnight Hunt Draft Booster Box contains 36 Innistrad: Midnight Hunt Draft Boosters (540 cards total). Each Draft Booster contains 15 Magic cards, 1 token or ad card, and 1 Helper card, with 1 Rare or Mythic Rare, 3 Uncommons, 10 Common cards, and 1 Land card. A traditional foil card of any rarity replaces a Common in 33% of Innistrad: Midnight Hunt Draft Boosters.
